# netscalersdx_ssl_cert (Resource)

Configuration for SSL Certificate File resource. Uploads a certificate file from a local path to the SDX appliance via `/nitro/v2/upload/ssl_cert`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netscalersdx_ssl_cert" "tf_ssl_cert" {
  file_name = "tf_ssl_cert.pem"
  # file_location_path is the local DIRECTORY that contains the file named by
  # file_name, on the machine running `terraform apply`. The uploaded file is
  # "<file_location_path>/<file_name>" (here /path/to/your/certs/tf_ssl_cert.pem)
  # and is stored on the SDX appliance under file_name.
  file_location_path = "/path/to/your/certs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_location_path` (String) File Location on Client for upload. This is the local filesystem **directory** that contains the certificate file named by `file_name`, on the machine running `terraform apply`. The uploaded file is `<file_location_path>/<file_name>`. Minimum length =  1
- `file_name` (String) File Name. The name of the certificate file inside `file_location_path`, and the name it is stored under on the SDX appliance (equals the resource `id`). Minimum length =  1 Maximum length =  256

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. It is the same as the `file_name` value.

### Read-Only

- `file_last_modified` (String) Last Modified timestamp of the file on the SDX appliance.
- `file_last_modified_epoch` (String) Last Modified (Epoch) timestamp of the file on the SDX appliance, in epoch seconds.
- `file_size` (Number) File size in bytes as reported by the SDX appliance.
